question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**convenience**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is: "The (4)__________ of plastic is overshadowed by its long-term environmental costs..."
 
• The correct noun form to indicate the quality of being convenient is "convenience."<
